summary.text: The verifier's reproduction test fails the same way before and after this fix, and 11 previously passing tests now fail, including header tests in tests/client/test_headers.py, the redirect no-body tests, and the empty-content/no-content tests. Look first at the value change in httpx._content_streams.ByteStream.get_headers, which the Judge labelled suspicious and which likely explains the empty-b…

labels.label: suspicious
labels.reason: The issue is about the sync Client being handed an ASGI app (its docstring says ASGI). Nothing in it mentions Content-Length on empty bodies, so adding 'Content-Length: 0' for body='' is unrequested.

labels.label: suspicious
labels.reason: The issue concerns ASGI apps used with the sync Client and asks nothing about ByteStream headers. Emitting 'Content-Length: 0' for b'' goes beyond what was reported.
